name: Battle of the Cooks

start.dialog: Flip: We're having a cooking competition! / Corny: But we need a judge! / Heat: Someone with TASTE! / All: Will you judge our dishes? Winner gets bragging rights! And prizes!
start.objective: Taste and judge the three Foodboys' signature dishes

progress.dialog: Flip: Try my fish fry! / Corny: No, my cornbread! / Heat: SPICY wings first! / All: Pick a winner!
progress.objective: Taste all three dishes and declare a winner

complete.dialog: All: We have a winner! Thanks for judging! Here - take our signature sauces! Each one unique! Use them to make any meal better!

party_comments.kade: They're all pretty good. Hard to choose.
party_comments.twist: Can I have more?! All of them?!
party_comments.suresh: The spicy one reminds me of home.

hidden_outcome: If you declare all three winners (diplomacy check), they combine forces to create 'Ultimate Fusion Dish' that gives a permanent stat boost
